# Stephen Irving

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) (spouse), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) (child)

## Appearance

Stephen Irving is a tall, handsome middle-aged man with a strong, sad face that is splendidly modeled around his brow and chin. He features iron-gray hair and deep-set, dark blue eyes.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)_

## Personality

Stephen Irving is a high-strung and sensitive individual who maintains a reserved demeanor. He possesses a deep and tender nature that he scrupulously hides from the world, and he is noted for being too proud to return.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## History

Twenty-five years after parting in anger from his former fiancee, [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), Stephen Irving returned and sent her a message through [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Upon visiting [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), he reunited with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and reconciled with her during a walk in the garden. Shortly thereafter, the two were married in an intimate garden ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before departing together from the station.

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P17](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0017), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P42](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0042), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), +7 more_

**Volume 2**

## Quotes

> "In Paul’s last letter he spoke of going with you to visit an old . . . friend of mine . . . Miss Lewis at the stone house in Grafton. Do you know her well?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P30](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0030)

> "Yes, I believe you are. Well, I am going to ask a favor of you. I would like to go and see Miss Lavendar if she will let me. Will you ask her if I may come?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035)

> "There is nothing changed about this house or garden since I was here twenty-five years ago. It makes me feel young again."
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P60](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0060)

> "I hardly knew my boy, he had grown so big and brown and sturdy."
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P27](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0027)

> "So this is my little son’s ‘beautiful teacher,’ of whom I have heard so much"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023)

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

[Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) is Stephen Irving's wife, though they were previously engaged when they were young before a long-ago quarrel separated them. After Stephen returned and sent a message through [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), he visited [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and reconciled with [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) in her garden. The two were soon married in an intimate garden ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before departing together.
